verdict.rationale: Motion does have a live REST API (X-API-Key auth) that is available to all users. But its documented scope is "creating, updating, and managing projects and tasks". Nothing in the evidence shows API or MCP endpoints for checking availability, or for booking, rescheduling, or cancelling meetings. Meeting booking appears only as a dashboard and embed feature for human prospects, which is adjacent to this story and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can check availability, book, reschedule, and cancel meetings end to end through the API or MCP — no dashboard needed
